arxiv-2104-01167.description: Abstract Object insertion is a classic contact-rich manipulation task. arxiv-2305-13574.creator: Wenbo Shi and Robert Malaney
arxiv-2305-13574.description: Abstract With sub-threshold quantum error correction on quantum hardware still out of reach, quantum error mitigation methods are currently deemed an attractive option for implementing certain applications on near-term noisy quantum devices. One such application is quantum routing - the ability to map an incoming quantum signal into a superposition of paths.

arxiv-2404-00392.description: Abstract . Street view imagery (SVI), largely captured via outfitted fleets or mounted dashcams in consumer vehicles is a rapidly growing source of geospatial data used in urban sensing and development. These datasets are often collected opportunistically, are massive in size, and vary in quality which limits the scope and extent of their use in urban planning.

arxiv-2404-07704.creator: Tobias Rindlisbacher
arxiv-2404-07704.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tobias Rindlisbacher. The Cayley-Hamilton theorem is used to implement an iterative process for the efficient numerical computation of matrix power series and their differentials. In addition to straight-forward applications in lattice gauge theory simulations e.g. to reduce the computational cost of smearing, the method can also be used to simplify the evaluation of OPEN SU ⁡ ( N CLOSE ) \operatorname{SU}\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(N}}\right) one-link integrals or the computation of OPEN SU ⁡ ( N CLOSE ) \operatorname{SU}\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(N}}\right) matrix logarithms.

arxiv-2407-11546.creator: Hyunchul Bae, Minhee Kang, Heejin Ahn
arxiv-2407-11546.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate improving the perception performance of autonomous vehicles through communication with other vehicles and road infrastructures.
